capabilities: Render ```jps code blocks and .jps files as paginated SVG jianpu scores
Play back scores with Web Audio synthesis using a SoundFont
Open, edit, and create .jps files via wikilinks, embeds, and a desktop editor
Adjust page layout by dragging guides that write back to a # jps-config line
Set per-score or plugin-default typography, margins, watermark, and background options
extras: The embedded full editor is desktop-only (needs Node.js access); on mobile, .jps files open as syntax-highlighted source with a preview. First playback downloads a ~32 MB GeneralUser GS SoundFont from a direct link (cacheable locally or user-imported). Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later; no telemetry or accounts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render, play, or edit musical notation, so musicians cannot embed or maintain jianpu scores inside their notes.

relations.evidence: 渲染引擎复用 @ijipu/engine（与 iJipu 应用一致）
